title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 200 East Main Street in Maroa, Illinois, as the "Jeremy L. Ridlen Post Office".
official_summary: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 200 East Main Street in Maroa, Illinois, as the Jeremy L. Ridlen Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named the Postal Service building at 200 East Main Street in Maroa, Illinois, after Jeremy L. Ridlen.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility in Maroa, Illinois, as the Jeremy L. Ridlen Post Office. It only changes the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 15, 2022.
